upstream_note: dz-original skill pack (ADR-001, features/book-knowledge-digitizer). Turns a book into an installable skill pack. Declares cross-pack dependencies so dz bundle's cross-skill-dep warning fires honestly.

@dzhechkov/skills-meta: skill-crystallizer (book-skill-distill delegates scaffold + benchmark by reference)
knowledge-extractor (book-knowledge-extract reuses its quality-gate discipline by reference)

system: poppler-utils (pdftotext, pdfinfo, pdfimages) for book-ingest; tesseract optional for scanned books

digitize-book.description: Orchestrator — book → installable pack through 5 checkpoints, resumable

book-ingest.description: Deterministic PDF → chunked corpus + manifest (poppler + heuristics, no LLM)

book-knowledge-extract.description: Corpus → verified Knowledge Units (map-reduce, KU-verify, fidelity regime)

book-skill-distill.description: Verified KUs → decision-moment skills (routing evals, traceability)

book-pack-assemble.description: Skills → installable pack (references/, private-default, collision gate)

book-kb-index.description: KUs → books.sqlite (lexical) + agentdb (vector) KB, upsert not append

book-brain-register.description: Optional terminal stage (CP6) — promote a project's KUs into the durable cross-project brain (~/.dz/brain/) via dz brain add

source-brain-ingest.description: Sibling (ADR §6) — deep-walk a repo/dir into the same KUs → same brain via dz brain add --from-kus --kind repo
